summary: Restore libvirt's standard emulator for appliance deployment and managed VMs. API impact: existing contract; only internal host domain generation changes.

guide.reason: Disclose the JPEG quality limitation and that upgrading does not automatically recover a failed appliance definition.

api.reason: Local deployment and agent vm-create/vm-update still create host-owned libvirt definitions and return existing operation results; console streams, authorization, validation, retries, observed state and client-facing contracts are unchanged.

state.reason: VM definitions stay durable on Core; this removes a generated emulator override and adds no Controller state.
state.record: Existing libvirt domain XML and appliance/managed operation journals on Core, reported through appliance and managed inventory for fresh Controller adoption with the same VM identity.

verification.method: Both emulator-selection regression checks failed against the old selectable wrapper. go test -race ./internal/vmhost ./internal/localcore passed after the fix; python3 -m unittest tests.test_build_source -v passed all 5 tests.
verification.limits: No rebuilt package, live AppArmor-enforced deployment, affected-host recovery or browser walkthrough. Hosted CI not run; both phase1 workflows already run the regression suite.
